sections.title: Audit: silent failures before and after the fixes
sections.dataLabel: 44-report test split, used for regression / development
sections.summary: The same 44 reports (40 supported, 4 unsupported) through each pipeline. This split was used to find and fix the defects, so it measures that they are closed, not how the system generalises.
caveats: The evidence layer was developed against the train and dev splits; this split is retired to regression use. Generalisation is measured on the frozen holdout below.

sections.title: Frozen holdout: correct detections, and refusals that matter
sections.dataLabel: 112 reports, frozen before the single run
sections.summary: Authored reports in voices the training corpus never used, unsupported and ambiguous cases, prompt-injection attempts, and 16 verbatim CISA/FBI advisory passages. Scored per component, as a complete rule, and downstream on the demonstration dataset.
caveats: Labels are from one annotator plus a blind LLM reviewer (kappa 0.886, six adjudicated disagreements). No independent human review has been done - see data/holdout/review/README.md.
The prompted-LLM rows use gpt-oss-20b: the 120B model's daily token quota was exhausted during development. Two aborted runs are archived under experiments/results/holdout/.
41 supported reports: intervals are wide. The parser was developed on the training corpus's distribution and not tuned after seeing these numbers; failures are published, not fixed.

sections.title: Reliability: does the test suite see the bugs it claims to?
sections.summary: A differential test of the Spark executor against an independent reference engine, a mutation check that plants defects to prove the harness can see them, streaming/batch agreement under the documented lateness policy, and hard-kill recovery.
caveats: Two implementations agreeing does not catch a misunderstanding they share; hand-computed golden scenarios and metamorphic properties cover that (tests/core).
Streaming recovery is 'effectively-once output under stated conditions', not an unconditional exactly-once guarantee - docs/spec/detection-semantics.md section 5.
sections.reproduce:
python scripts/verify/differential.py --cases 100
python scripts/verify/mutation_check.py
python scripts/verify/streaming_agreement.py
python scripts/verify/streaming_recovery.py

sections.title: Benchmarks: single-machine local Spark
sections.summary: Batch completion time per behaviour with cold start reported separately, raw observations kept, and only the statistics the number of repetitions supports.
caveats: Everything ran on ONE machine: this is local-mode Spark. It is not evidence of horizontal scalability, and no such claim is made.
